name: boutique-market
description: White-label boutique e-commerce — React, TypeScript, Node, GraphQL, MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @boutique-market/api" "npm run dev -w @boutique-market/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @boutique-market/shared && npm run build -w @boutique-market/api && npm run build -w @boutique-market/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @boutique-market/web && npm run lint -w @boutique-market/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @boutique-market/shared && npm run typecheck -w @boutique-market/api && npm run typecheck -w @boutique-market/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @boutique-market/shared && npm run test -w @boutique-market/api
